messages:
ashok: Quick sync 
Proposal: reduce late-enrich cost for noisy mobile traces by batching them into a short window and creating lightweight tombstones for keys that never resolve. Tombstoned keys are skipped by future enrich attempts until TTL. This should cut repeated redundant lookups.

sarah: High level sounds good. Curious about numbers and query correctness tradeoffs.

ashok: Example: 1.5M mobile traces/day, ~4% late-join. If we call enrich every 15m we get many redundant calls. Tombstone approach: window=5m, tombstone_ttl=24h. Storage for tombstones is tiny (MBs) vs CPU of repeated enrich lookups.

tj: Main question: what do queries see if tombstoned? We need clear semantics.

kevin: Suggest two modes on read: 1) strict (billing engine) -> trigger backfill-on-read if tombstone present, 2) best-effort (dashboards) -> return cohort-level attribution and label as "deferred".

maria: Operational pieces: atomic tombstone writes with versioning, GC, and a windowed batch consumer. Also normalize keys before grouping to avoid multiple keys for same user causing mis-tombstoning.

ashok: Implementation sketch: small KV table keyed by (tenant, key_hash) with value = "version|created_ts|reason". Version = epoch ms. Tombstone write is conditional (only write if incoming version > existing). Delete happens when enrich returns a valid billing_key with higher version.

kevin: Config knobs: window_seconds (default 300), tombstone_ttl_seconds (default 86400), backfill_on_read boolean, per-tenant overrides.

sarah: Metrics and alerts: enrichment.windowed.count, enrichment.tombstone.created, enrichment.tombstone.hit_rate, enrichment.backfill.triggered. Alert if tombstone.hit_rate > 20% rolling 24h.

tj: Consumer flow: ingest fast-path writes to short-lived window topic for missing-billing_key traces. Windowed consumer groups by normalized key, checks KV tombstone atomically, and enriches only non-tombstoned keys. At end of window, if key unresolved, write tombstone version=now and emit metric.

maria: Edge case: late-arriving true billing_key after tombstone. We support tombstone-delete: enrich service issues conditional delete with version > tombstone_version. Between tombstone and delete reads may see "unknown" temporarily  document eventual consistency.

ashok: Rollout plan: opt-in per-tenant feature flag. Canary 2% traffic, measure enrichment_invocations_per_trace, enrichment_p99_latency, tombstone_hit_rate.

ingest-bot: scheduled: enrichment-deferred-canary -> 2% traffic -> Wed 03:00 UTC

kevin: Next steps: draft RFC with pseudocode for KV API, consumer pseudocode, config, and cost model. I'll produce cost estimates after canary metrics.

ashok: I'll open the RFC PR now. Please review for semantics, config, and rollback plan. Thanks!
